name: worldmonitor-sih26163-assessment
description: SIH 26163 — WorldMonitor security assessment: advisory-aware Seam-Linter, CVSS 3.1+4.0 + EPSS scoring, a safety-enforced dynamic probe against a real running local instance, and minimal local reproductions. Zero external dependencies by design (Node 18+ only).

scripts.seam-lint: node framework/seam-linter/analyze-invariants.mjs .cache/worldmonitor-src && node framework/seam-linter/rate-limit-coverage-check.mjs .cache/worldmonitor-src && node framework/seam-linter/cors-scan.mjs .cache/worldmonitor-src && node framework/seam-linter/cast-adjacency.mjs .cache/worldmonitor-src && node framework/seam-linter/chronological-orphans.mjs
scripts.scan:all-static: npm run endpoints && npm run scan:auth-session && npm run scan:authz-access && npm run scan:input-validation && npm run scan:api-security && npm run scan:sca && npm run scan:secrets
scripts.report-app:dev: npm run report-app:data && npm --prefix report-app run dev -- --open
scripts.report-app:build: npm run report-app:data && npm --prefix report-app run build
scripts.assess: npm run scan:all-static && npm run report-app:build
